name: gizza-ai/image-resize-to-filesize
summary: Compress an image to a target file size in KB by searching the best JPEG/WebP quality

tool.description: Compress an image to a target file size in KB. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call), a target_kb budget, and optionally format (jpg/webp) and max_width. The tool binary-searches the encoder quality for the highest quality whose file is at or under target_kb, optionally shrinking the width first. Output is JPEG or WebP (PNG has no quality knob to search).

format.description: Output format for the lossy quality search: "jpg" (widest support) or "webp" (smaller at equal quality). Default jpg.

max_width.description: Optional cap on output width in pixels (0 = keep original size). Shrinks only, never upscales. Use a smaller value when the target can't be reached at full resolution.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

target_kb.description: Target maximum output size in KB, e.g. 200. The tool searches the highest encoder quality whose file is at or under this budget (1 MB = 1024 KB).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
